title: This Wasp Paralyzes a Tarantula in Seconds (Top Pain Rating)

scenes.text: This wasp can paralyse a tarantula in seconds.
It's the tarantula hawk, about two inches long, and it hunts tarantulas on purpose.
Its sting scores a four out of four on the Schmidt pain index. Traumatically painful.
A human recovers in a few minutes. The tarantula does not get that deal.
The wasp drags the paralysed spider into a burrow and lays one egg on it.
When the larva hatches, the spider is the nursery.

description:
